values.main.benchmark.warnDriveProbe: Drive speed could not be measured, so the recommendation uses RAM and CPU only.
values.main.benchmark.warnRecommendationLowered: Text generation measured about {tps} tokens per second with the loaded model ({model}), so the recommended model was moved down one size tier to keep answers quick on this computer.
values.main.benchmark.warnSlowDrive: This drive is on the slower side. Models will still work, but loading them may take longer.
values.main.benchmark.warnSlowRead: Reading from this drive measured about {mbps} MB/s. Starting a model reads its whole file at that speed, so model starts will be slow on this drive.
values.main.benchmark.warnSpeedSkipped: Text-generation speed was not measured this time, because the model was busy with something else. The profile below uses RAM, CPU and drive speed only — run the benchmark again when nothing else is using the model for a full reading.
values.main.benchmark.warnTiny: This device is best suited for the smallest, quickest model. Larger models may run slowly.
values.main.benchmark.warnUnknown: We could not fully detect this hardware, so we picked a safe, lightweight model. You can try a larger model any time.
values.main.benchmark.warnVeryLowTokens: Text generation was very slow with the loaded model ({model}), so the assigned profile was stepped down one level. If that model is larger than the recommended one, start the recommended model and run the benchmark again.
values.main.chat.docTaskBusy: A document task is running. You can cancel it, or wait for it to finish before chatting.
values.main.engine.filesUnreadable: The AI engine could not read one of its files just now. Another program may be using it (an antivirus scan, for example). Please try again in a minute.
values.main.ingest.audioEngineUnsupported: Audio import is not available on this operating system yet: the app cannot install the voice engine it needs here.
values.main.ingest.audioNeedsEngine: Audio import needs the voice engine — install it on the AI Model screen.
values.main.ingest.audioNeedsModelAndEngine: Audio import needs the transcription model and the voice engine — add both on the AI Model screen.
values.main.ingest.audioNeedsTranscriber: Audio import needs the transcription model — download it on the AI Model screen.
values.main.ingest.audioTranscriptionFailed: The recording could not be transcribed. Re-index this document to try again.
values.main.ingest.audioUnreadable: This audio file could not be read. Convert it to WAV or MP3 and import it again.
values.main.ingest.engineCannotRun: The AI engine can't run on this computer, so this document could not be indexed. The AI Model screen says what to do — then try again.
values.main.ingest.engineLibraryMissing: The AI engine can't run on this computer because the system library {library} is missing. The AI Model screen says how to fix it — then try again.
values.main.ingest.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to import safely. Split it into smaller files and try again.
values.main.ingest.imageNeedsOcr: Photo import needs the text-recognition (OCR) files, which are not on this drive.
values.main.ingest.imageNoText: No readable text was found in this photo. Try a sharper, closer picture of the page.
values.main.ingest.imageOcrFailed: This photo couldn't be read. Re-index it to try again.
values.main.ingest.imageOcrUnavailable: Text recognition (OCR) could not run in this build, so this photo was stored without readable text. Re-index it once OCR is available.
values.main.ingest.interrupted: Ingestion was interrupted before it finished. Re-index to try again.
values.main.ingest.parseTimeout: This file took too long to process and was skipped. It may be damaged or extremely large.
values.main.ingest.pdfScanDetected: This PDF looks like a scan — it has no readable text yet.
values.main.ingest.searchModelCannotStart: The search model could not start, so this document could not be indexed. On the AI Model screen, choose Check all model files — then try again.
values.main.ingest.searchModelFailed: The search model ran into a problem, so this document could not be indexed. Try again.
values.main.ingest.searchModelTimeout: The search model did not respond in time, so this document could not be indexed. Try again.
values.main.ingest.sourceMissing: Source file not found on disk.
values.main.ingest.tooManyChunks: This document is too large to fully index. Split it into smaller files and import the parts.
values.main.ingest.unsupportedType: This file type isn't supported ({ext}). Try TXT, PDF, DOCX, CSV, or a supported audio format.
values.main.ingest.voiceEngineCannotRun: The voice engine can't run on this computer, so this recording could not be transcribed. The AI Model screen says what to do — then re-index this document.
values.main.ingest.voiceModelPathUnsupported: On Windows, the voice engine cannot open the transcription model because a folder or file name in the model’s path contains an umlaut, an accent or another non-ASCII character. Store the model under a path without such characters and update its entry in the model’s manifest, then re-index this document.
values.main.rag.noContext: I couldn't find this in your documents. Try rephrasing your question, or check which documents you're asking about.
values.main.rag.reindexNeeded: Your documents need a quick re-index before they can be searched — they were indexed with a different search model. Open the Documents screen and choose Re-index.
